einzeiler: How charisma works as a learnable skill with Olivia Fox Cabane.
kurzfassung: Olivia Fox Cabane explains that charisma is a learnable skill rather than an innate trait. The episode examines core elements like presence, introversion, and self-compassion. It also explores how people form initial impressions before any words are spoken.
stichpunkte: The three qualities that make someone charismatic
Why introverts can be highly magnetic
How people judge you before you speak
Why presence matters more than performance
The link between confidence and self-compassion
Simple ways to become more charismatic
beschreibung:
Why do some people instantly draw us in?

Olivia Fox Cabane reveals that charisma is not a gift. It is a skill - and most of us misunderstand what creates it.

In this episode, you’ll learn:
The three qualities that make someone charismatic
Why introverts can be highly magnetic
How people judge you before you speak
Why presence matters more than performance
The surprising link between confidence and self-compassion
Simple ways to become more charismatic immediately

Charisma is not just how people feel about you.

It is how you make them feel about themselves.

Olivia Fox Cabane is the author of The Charisma Myth.
